summary: Kaniksu NF 10-foot L-4 tower near Eastport, built 1937; destroyed 1958 per two sources, though Forest Lookouts lists it only as Removed.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date its destruction to 1958; Forest Lookouts lists it only as Removed

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; no source describes what remains or whether it is open to the public

evidence.supports: about a mile southwest of Eastport

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date the loss to 1958 as destruction; Forest Lookouts lists the site as Removed with no date. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Brief record matches the sources: Boundary County, Kaniksu NF, 1937 build, 1958 destruction. The Forest Lookouts Removed status conflicts with destroyed 1958 and is reported as a conflict. One WebSearch found no cause or date beyond the listings, so no cause is written. Staffing names come from firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. The Idaho Fire Lookouts hike-in note is the only access statement. Confidence medium.
